intent_snapshot.goal: Codify the review-retro root-cause lessons into the reviewer prompt, Loop and Planner contracts, one ADR, and the workflow-evidence-retro skill, so repeated same-invariant rework demands a generalization argument (or a contract-boundary refutation) instead of another single-trigger patch. Brainstorm trace: BR-REQ-1 -> AC1, BR-REQ-3 -> AC2, BR-REQ-2 -> AC3, BR-REQ-4 -> AC4; BR-DEC-1/2/3 are captured by the AC1/AC3 wording; BR-OUT-1 (host-side subagent lifecycle repair), BR-OUT-2 (evasive-code sandbox containment) and BR-OUT-3 (any writes during framing) are excluded.

acceptance.assertion: The reviewer prompt plugins/immune-brain/runtime/prompts/code-review.md and its exact mirror plugins/immune-brain/dist/role-prompts/code-review.md carry a rule that a rework finding repeating an acceptance or anchor already reworked in the same task must demand a generalization argument covering every known trigger class of the violated invariant; and the Loop contract plugins/immune-brain/dist/imm-loop.md rework guidance requires the fix response to either justify that the fix covers all known triggers of that invariant or declare the trigger out-of-contract and answer with refute_finding bound to fresh QA evidence, instead of patching only the reported trigger.

The Planner contract plugins/immune-brain/dist/imm-planner.md requires that adding a field or verdict branch to a state machine first enumerates every consuming union/version-gate branch across its owners (for example reducer.ts, validation.ts, coordinator.ts) and records them in scope discovery before authoring, instead of changing only the producing side.

docs/adr/0012-authority-uniqueness-keys.md exists with status frontmatter and records the settled principle that authority and audit uniqueness judgments use run_id plus enrollment_event_id or intent_content_hash (with task_id display-only, never a sole dedup or delete basis), and enumerates the remaining coarse-grained key sites as an explicit tech-debt list.

.agents/skills/workflow-evidence-retro/SKILL.md gains a task-level aggregation step: group review rounds by (cwd, task_id), flag tasks with three or more rounds for acceptance_id repetition analysis, and annotate infrastructure-jitter rounds (cleaned-up subagent or empty verdict) instead of counting them as content rework.
